diagnosticCalibrations.details: The original1000px/s global translation gate falsely classified connected prop arcs during a420ms two-arm raise. All140 painted entry/return views were inspected. Preserve strict boundary4px/1000px/s and angular12deg/1500deg/s gates; require a non-boundary translation20px/4000px/s to indicate a discontinuity. Raw RAF traces are unchanged and SHA-verified.
